Application Data.NAME: Smith Construction Services, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Construction Services, LLC specializes in residential and commercial construction projects, including new builds, renovations, and remodeling. With a team of experienced general contractors, we manage all aspects of construction from initial design and permitting to project completion. Our services include site evaluation, project planning, subcontractor management, and quality assurance. We are dedicated to delivering high-quality workmanship while adhering to safety standards and timelines. Additionally, we offer custom renovations to suit client needs, ensuring satisfaction throughout the construction process.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred from a subcontractor's negligence during a renovation project on 07/10/2023, resulting in water damage to the property. Amount: $10,000. Status: Claim filed and currently under review with the insurance adjuster.
